_readme: Flow profiles. kind + size pick a profile (select); a flow:<profile> label or the profile state field overrides it. A profile is an ordered list of steps; a step named gate:<name> stops the run and raises that human gate. steps maps a step to the agent that runs it (empty: the orchestrator invokes the flow:<skill> skill, which spawns what it needs), whether it needs the claimed worktree, and the skill that carries the procedure. review_depth feeds the review step. architect says per profile whether the design step runs the architect: only L tasks and epics, where its cost pays; off, the design step ends with the exploration and the planner designs from it.

grill.summary: Interview the owner until the epic has a testable spec (flow:plan, interviewer).

epic.summary: Write the epic body: problem, solution, scope, acceptance, invalidated invariants (flow:plan, planner).

tasks.summary: Decompose the epic into tracker tasks with sizes, blockers and acceptance ownership (flow:plan, planner).

closeout.summary: Check every task of the epic is closed, run the epic-level verification, close the epic (flow:verify, verifier).

reproduce.summary: Write the failing test that reproduces the bug and commit it (test-writer).

design.summary: Explore, research and design: explorer, researcher when needed, architect when the profile turns it on (architect); design.md in the reports (flow:plan).

plan.summary: Write plan.md: phases with acceptance checks, touches globs, decomposition mode; sub-items when tracker tasks (planner).

implement.summary: Implement the plan in the claimed worktree, independent phases in parallel temp worktrees, and commit (flow:implement, implementer).

test.summary: Write the tests from the acceptance lines, not from the code, and commit (test-writer).

review.summary: Run the review engine on the diff at the profile's depth; P0 sends it back to implement (flow:review).

verify.summary: Run build, format, tests, mutation and the project gates through verify.sh; write verify.json (verifier).

explain.summary: Plain-language HTML summary plus a short quiz the owner answers on the PR (flow:explain).

sync.summary: Merge the refs the health job could not merge cleanly into the task branch, resolve the conflicts, check and push; the item's own step follows (implementer). In no profile: next.sh runs it when the reports hold sync.md.

pr.summary: Open or update the PR: base from the parent, house body, verify report, draft when a quiz exists, review requests (pr-creator).

interview.asks: Confirm the spec recap, or say what to change.

plan-approval.asks: Approve the plan, approve it with notes, or send it back.
plan-approval.says: plan path and a one-paragraph summary

decomposition.asks: Approve the split, or send it back.
decomposition.says: the task list, sizes and dependencies

feel-test.asks: Launch it and sign off, or report what feels wrong.
feel-test.says: what to launch and what to look for

merge.says: PR URL and the verify summary

escalation.asks: Say what the agent should do.

ambiguity.says: the question and the two readings
